name: Vexa
install:
set -e
corepack enable
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" ]; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; fi
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" ]; then sudo -n ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" /usr/local/bin/uv 2>/dev/null || true; sudo -n ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/uvx" /usr/local/bin/uvx 2>/dev/null || true; fi
ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL=skip pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

terminals.name: terminal
terminals.description: Vexa Terminal (Next.js) dev server on http://localhost:3000. Serves the terminal UI; connect a backend via GATEWAY_URL / VEXA_ADMIN_API_URL for full functionality.
